# Night's Catch

Source: https://nightscatch.co.uk/

> 4-star dog-friendly fisherman's cottage in Porthleven, Cornwall. Sleeps 3. Book via Cornish Horizons.

## Property

Night's Catch is a beautifully renovated fisherman's cottage at 17 Thomas Street, Porthleven, Cornwall, TR13 9DG.

- Sleeps 3
- 2 bedrooms: one king-size bed, one single bed
- Official Cornish Horizons 4-star rated holiday property
- Dog friendly
- Wood-burning stove in the lounge
- Tastefully restored rustic interior
- Short walk to Porthleven harbour, beach, shops, pubs, and restaurants
- On-street parking (no dedicated private parking)

Official listing: https://www.cornishhorizons.co.uk/cottage/oc-26807-nights-catch
Contact: https://www.cornishhorizons.co.uk/contact-us

## About Porthleven

Porthleven is a coastal town on the south coast of Cornwall with beaches, a harbour, seafood restaurants, independent shops, and local art galleries.

Local walks include the coastal path to Loe Bar and Rinsey Head. Porthleven has a strong food scene, from Michelin-starred restaurants to traditional Cornish pubs.

## Guest reviews

Aggregate rating from the reviews published on this site: 4.8 out of 5 (5 reviews).

- Malcolm, 30 August 2026, 5 stars: Lovely stay in a very clean, well equipped cottage, great location easy walk to the harbour, beach, local shops, pubs and restaurants. Within easy reach to much of Cornwall. Happily stay here again indeed hope to do so.
- Lydia, 27 July 2026, 4.6 stars: A really beautiful house and very comfortable stay. Easy short walk in to centre of Porthleven with a wide range of shops and restaurants. It was the perfect stay. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Porthleven.
- Alison, 8 June 2026, 4.6 stars: Beautifully renovated and convenient for visiting the Lizard. Tasteful, very clean. Street parking outside the cottage most days. Better than the photos. Would stay again.
- Tania, 19 January 2026, 4.8 stars: Home from home. Great location. Great neighbours. Will keep coming back.
- Nikki, 4 December 2025, 5 stars: Lovely cottage, beautifully renovated and tucked away but still very close to the harbour. Good pub and restaurants. Great coastal walks. Easy reach of Mousehole and Mullion Cove.
